destinations.name: Varanasi
destinations.blurb: World's oldest living city — Kashi Vishwanath, Ganga Aarti & sacred ghats.

destinations.name: Mathura
destinations.blurb: Birthplace of Lord Krishna — Krishna Janmabhoomi, Dwarkadhish Temple.

destinations.name: Vrindavan
destinations.blurb: Land of Krishna's divine childhood — Banke Bihari, Prem Mandir, Govardhan.

destinations.name: Bodhgaya
destinations.blurb: Where the Buddha attained enlightenment — Mahabodhi Temple, Bodhi Tree.

destinations.name: Char Dham
destinations.blurb: Kedarnath, Badrinath, Gangotri & Yamunotri — the holiest circuit in the Himalayas.

destinations.name: Haridwar
destinations.blurb: Gateway to the gods — Har Ki Pauri, Ganga Aarti, Chandi Devi & Mansa Devi.

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.blurb: Yoga capital of the world — Triveni Ghat, Neelkanth Mahadev, Ram Jhula.

destinations.name: Nasik
destinations.blurb: Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga, Panchavati & Kumbh Mela city on the Godavari.

destinations.name: Shirdi
destinations.blurb: Sai Baba's sacred abode — Samadhi Mandir, Dwarkamai, Chavadi & Shani Shingnapur.

destinations.name: Mahabaleshwar
destinations.blurb: Mahabaleshwar temple, Pratapgad fort & scenic hill station pilgrimage.

destinations.name: Nanded
destinations.blurb: Hazur Sahib Gurudwara — one of the five Takhts of Sikhism, on the Godavari.

destinations.name: Palitana
destinations.blurb: Shatrunjaya Hill — 900+ Jain temples, the holiest pilgrimage site in Jainism.

destinations.name: Dwarka
destinations.blurb: Dwarkadhish Temple — one of the Char Dhams and the legendary city of Lord Krishna.

destinations.name: Pushkar
destinations.blurb: World's only Brahma Temple — sacred Pushkar Lake, Savitri Temple & Camel Fair.

destinations.name: Guruvayur
destinations.blurb: Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple — Kerala's most important Vaishnavite shrine.

destinations.name: Hampi
destinations.blurb: Virupaksha Temple & the ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire — a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

destinations.name: Gokarna
destinations.blurb: Mahabaleshwar temple on the Arabian Sea coast — a serene alternative to Goa.

destinations.name: Omkareshwar
destinations.blurb: Island Jyotirlinga on the Narmada — Omkareshwar & Mamleshwar temples.

destinations.name: Ujjain
destinations.blurb: Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga — one of the seven Moksha-giving cities & Kumbh Mela site.

destinations.name: Mahakaleshwar
destinations.blurb: The only south-facing Jyotirlinga — Bhasma Aarti at dawn is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

destinations.name: Maheshwar
destinations.blurb: Ancient temple town on the Narmada — Ahilya Bai Holkar fort & ghats.

destinations.name: Chidambaram
destinations.blurb: Nataraja temple — Lord Shiva as the cosmic dancer, one of the Pancha Bhuta Stalas.

destinations.name: Madurai
destinations.blurb: Meenakshi Amman Temple — a Dravidian architectural marvel and living pilgrimage centre.

destinations.name: Kanyakumari
destinations.blurb: Southernmost tip of India — Kumari Amman Temple, Vivekananda Rock Memorial.

destinations.name: Kanchipuram
destinations.blurb: City of 1000 temples — Ekambareswarar, Kamakshi Amman & Varadharaja Perumal.

destinations.name: Rameshwaram
destinations.blurb: Ramanathaswamy Temple — one of the Char Dhams, Agni Theertham on the sea.

destinations.name: Tanjore
destinations.blurb: Brihadeeswarar Temple — a UNESCO World Heritage Site and Chola architectural wonder.

destinations.name: Trichy
destinations.blurb: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple at Srirangam — the largest functioning Hindu temple in the world.

destinations.name: Tirupati
destinations.blurb: Tirumala Venkateswara — the most visited and richest temple in the world.

destinations.name: Puttaparthi
destinations.blurb: Prasanthi Nilayam — Sathya Sai Baba's ashram, a centre of peace and devotion.

destinations.name: Bhubaneswar
destinations.blurb: Temple city of India — Lingaraj Temple, Mukteshwar & hundreds of ancient shrines.

destinations.name: Puri
destinations.blurb: Jagannath Temple — one of the Char Dhams, home of the famous Rath Yatra festival.

destinations.name: Konark
destinations.blurb: Sun Temple — a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the magnificent chariot of the Sun God.

destinations.name: Deoghar
destinations.blurb: Baidyanath Jyotirlinga — one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, major Shravani Mela site.

destinations.name: Kolkata
destinations.blurb: Dakshineswar Kali Temple, Belur Math & Kalighat — spiritual heart of Bengal.

destinations.name: Kangra
destinations.blurb: Bajreshwari Mata Temple — ancient Shakti Peeth in the Kangra valley.

destinations.name: Dharamshala / Mecleodganj
destinations.blurb: Dalai Lama's residence — Namgyal Monastery & Tibetan Buddhist pilgrimage.

destinations.name: Manikaran
destinations.blurb: Hot springs & Gurudwara Manikaran Sahib — sacred to both Sikhs and Hindus.

destinations.name: Chamunda Devi
destinations.blurb: Chamunda Devi Temple near Dharamshala — powerful Shakti Peeth on the Baner River.

destinations.name: Renukaji
destinations.blurb: Renuka Lake & Parashurama temple — serene pilgrimage in the Sirmaur hills.

destinations.name: Chintpurni
destinations.blurb: Chintpurni Mata — one of the 51 Shakti Peethas, in Una district.

destinations.name: Paonta Sahib
destinations.blurb: Historic Gurudwara on the Yamuna — where Guru Gobind Singh composed scriptures.

destinations.name: Katra / Vaishno Devi
destinations.blurb: Vaishno Devi Shrine — one of the most visited pilgrimage sites in India, in the Trikuta Mountains.

destinations.name: Jammu
destinations.blurb: Raghunath Temple, Ranbireshwar Temple & Peer Kho Cave — the city of temples.

destinations.name: Amritsar
destinations.blurb: Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) — the holiest shrine in Sikhism, a symbol of equality.

destinations.name: Anandpur Sahib
destinations.blurb: Birthplace of the Khalsa — Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib & Hola Mohalla festival.

destinations.name: Naina Devi
destinations.blurb: Naina Devi Temple — a Shakti Peeth atop a hill in Bilaspur, Himachal border.

destinations.name: Panchkula (Mansa Devi)
destinations.blurb: Mansa Devi Temple on Shivalik Hills — popular Shakti Peeth near Chandigarh.

meta.description: Pilgrimage packages to sacred destinations across India — Varanasi, Tirupati, Shirdi, Vaishno Devi, Rameshwaram, Puri and many more.

customCta.heading: We Build Custom Pilgrimage Packages
customCta.body: Have a specific shrine, route, or group size in mind? Our pilgrimage experts will craft a personalised itinerary just for you — any destination, any duration, any budget.
